name: ComPatch LLWA + Victorian Century
short_description: LLWA loads last in the target chain and its REPLACE: on three rail production methods is a bare full body, silently dropping VC's job-attractiveness modifier. This puts VC's INJECT back on top of LLWA's own body. Load after both. The ai_strategies half of this pair (great_reforms/meiji_restoration/tanzimat_reforms, three-way with Kuromi's AI) ships in the LLWA+KAI ComPatch instead -- see its README.
